test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lz4_short_sequences_fast (value String CODEC(LZ4)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, min_compress_block_size = 16384, max_compress_block_size = 16384

CREATE TABLE lz4_short_sequences_hc (value String CODEC(LZ4HC(3))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, min_compress_block_size = 16384, max_compress_block_size = 16384

CREATE TABLE lz4_short_sequences_repeated (value String CODEC(LZ4)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, min_compress_block_size = 16384, max_compress_block_size = 16384
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lz4_short_sequences_fast SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> char(65 + cityHash64(number, toUInt64(i)) % 8), range(64))) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 100000000
INSERT INTO lz4_short_sequences_hc SELECT value FROM lz4_short_sequences_fast SETTINGS max_block_size = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 100000000
INSERT INTO lz4_short_sequences_repeated SELECT repeat('a', 64) FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 100000000
